title: Hanged sound playground
format: 16-bit PCM WAV masters; 128 kbps MP3 previews

cues.name: Soft key press
cues.trigger: On an accepted key press; light enough for many guesses.

cues.name: Letter found
cues.trigger: A correct guess; use one cue even when the letter occurs several times.

cues.name: Not that letter
cues.trigger: A wrong guess: a gentle wooden knock before the balloon pops.

cues.name: Tile settles
cues.trigger: A newly revealed letter settles into place; keep below the correct-guess cue.

cues.name: A new word
cues.trigger: Tiles arrive for a new round; also covers the initial word deal.

cues.name: Two letters revealed
cues.trigger: The two bought letters appear, alongside the spending sound.

cues.name: Word complete
cues.trigger: The winning guess; leave room for the selected character to celebrate.

cues.name: A gentle try again
cues.trigger: A warm unresolved-to-resolved response after the landing, never an alarm.

cues.name: Result stamp
cues.trigger: The result stamp lands: 700 ms after a normal win, 2600 ms after a loss.

cues.name: Rubber stretches
cues.trigger: The first 144 ms of an ordinary 900 ms balloon transition.

cues.name: Balloon pop
cues.trigger: At 16% of a normal transition: 144 ms. Rounded snap, rubber body, air.

cues.name: Last balloon strains
cues.trigger: The 352 ms lead-in to the final pop (16% of the 2200 ms fall).

cues.name: Last balloon pop
cues.trigger: At 352 ms in the final transition. A little fuller, without a frightening bang.

cues.name: Empty string drops
cues.trigger: The scrap and string droop while the character notices the missing lift.

cues.name: Little elastic drop
cues.trigger: After an ordinary pop, the character drops and gently rebounds.

cues.name: Falling air
cues.trigger: From 836 ms to 1320 ms in the last-balloon animation.

cues.name: Cushioned thud
cues.trigger: At 1320 ms: round low thump, soft grit, and a springy body. Dazed, never hurt.

cues.name: Small rebound
cues.trigger: The second, smaller contact at about 1584 ms.

cues.name: Dust settles
cues.trigger: A quiet supporting layer behind the impact and rebound.

cues.name: Seeing little stars
cues.trigger: One brief orbit after landing; no continuous ringing loop.

cues.name: Reward appears
cues.trigger: The reward badge appears before its 300 ms hold.

cues.name: Tokens leave the purse
cues.trigger: A successful spend; distinct from an unaffordable purchase.

cues.name: Coin in flight
cues.trigger: A 620 ms flight. Launch is 540 ms after a gain appears, or 360 ms for a spend.

cues.name: Reward lands
cues.trigger: The flight reaches the counter and the balance begins to change.

cues.name: Payment settles
cues.trigger: The spending flight reaches the header; a compact, lower coin response.

cues.name: Counter tick
cues.trigger: Supporting ticks during the count, capped to a short burst instead of one per token.

cues.name: Not enough tokens
cues.trigger: One soft double knock on a refused purchase; no harsh buzzer.

cues.name: Streak opens
cues.trigger: The celebration card enters over the game.

cues.name: Meter fills
cues.trigger: A 620 ms rising texture: 280 ms entrance, then 380 ms waiting, then fill.

cues.name: Star clicks home
cues.trigger: At the end of the fill, the cell star lands.

cues.name: Bonus blooms
cues.trigger: A full meter celebrates 260 ms after the star lands.

cues.name: Confetti puff
cues.trigger: A light paper puff and flutter for streaks, unlocks, and the summit.

cues.name: Climb the path
cues.trigger: 950 ms of travel, after the card waits 450 ms.

cues.name: Slide down the path
cues.trigger: 1150 ms of travel; playful and gentle.

cues.name: New level reached
cues.trigger: On landing, with the stop pop and sparkles.

cues.name: A softer landing
cues.trigger: An encouraging settling sound; no failure alarm.

cues.name: Unfold the world
cues.trigger: Tap the level pill to open the map.

cues.name: Fold the world
cues.trigger: The map closes with a short soft sweep.

cues.name: Clouds part
cues.trigger: A 700 ms airy reveal as the fog lifts from the castle.

cues.name: The whole sky opens
cues.trigger: The largest musical reward in the set; reserved for reaching the summit.

cues.name: Crown settles
cues.trigger: A small golden contact after the summit reveal.

cues.name: Meet the next character
cues.trigger: The viewed character changes; a short swish without speaking on every fast swipe.

cues.name: Character chosen
cues.trigger: A confident little confirmation, with that character’s greeting.

cues.name: Lock opens
cues.trigger: The lock releases after a successful purchase.

cues.name: Welcome to the collection
cues.trigger: A joyful reveal under the character’s voice and confetti.

cues.name: Welcome ribbon
cues.trigger: A soft ribbon flick as the banner settles.

cues.name: Soft button
cues.trigger: An accepted ordinary button press. Avoid layering it under another dedicated cue.

cues.name: Raised button press
cues.trigger: A deeper tactile press for Next word, Play, and other prominent actions.

cues.name: Change tab
cues.trigger: Only when changing to a different enabled tab.

cues.name: Back one page
cues.trigger: Back navigation, including Profile and info pages.

cues.name: Open a panel
cues.trigger: Profile, game rules, privacy, terms, support, and credits open.

cues.name: Close or cancel
cues.trigger: Dismiss a sheet or cancel editing; also suitable for skipping the streak card.

cues.name: Open a link
cues.trigger: A subtle outward flick for an external link.

cues.name: Ready to edit
cues.trigger: The player opens the name field. OS keyboard clicks should remain OS-controlled.

cues.name: Roll a friendly name
cues.trigger: A little tumble with a definite final settle.

cues.name: Name saved
cues.trigger: After a valid changed name is saved.

cues.name: Name needs a change
cues.trigger: Only on a refused Save, not every keystroke or live validation update.

cues.name: A moment to consider
cues.trigger: An understated opening sound for the confirmation sheet.

cues.name: Confirm deletion
cues.trigger: A restrained acknowledgement when confirmation is accepted.

cues.name: A fresh page
cues.trigger: A quiet page turn after successful deletion, without a celebration.

cues.name: Could not finish
cues.trigger: A soft interruption when a user-requested operation fails.

cues.name: Switch ranking period
cues.trigger: A compact sliding click when the period changes.

cues.name: Pull and release
cues.trigger: At release of a deliberate refresh, or tap on Try again.

cues.name: Scores refreshed
cues.trigger: One quiet acknowledgement after a user-requested refresh succeeds.

cues.name: Connection unavailable
cues.trigger: Only after an explicit failed refresh; silent background failures stay silent.

emotions.name: Picked / hello
emotions.use: Chosen in the shop; a restrained greeting on a new session.

emotions.name: Win / delight
emotions.use: A completed word, a new unlock, or a level-up.

emotions.name: Oops / worried
emotions.use: Occasional reaction after a balloon pops; not every key.

emotions.name: Falling
emotions.use: The short air-drop portion of the final fall.

emotions.name: Landing grunt
emotions.use: A brief comic exertion sound on impact, not a cry of pain.

emotions.name: Dazed / recovery
emotions.use: A small puzzled vocal after the bounce, then quiet.

scenes.name: A correct letter
scenes.description: A soft key, a warm answer, and the tile opening.

scenes.name: One balloon pops
scenes.description: The wrong key, rubber tension, a pop, then a little worried reaction.

scenes.name: The last balloon
scenes.description: Last pop → pause in the air → fall → cushioned landing → dazed recovery.

scenes.name: Word complete
scenes.description: The last letter, a delighted character, the result stamp, and earned tokens.

scenes.name: Buy two letters
scenes.description: Payment leaves the balance and two letters come into view.

scenes.name: Complete a streak
scenes.description: The star fills, settles, and bursts into a token bonus.

scenes.name: Unlock a character
scenes.description: A purchase, a tiny lock, a big welcome, and a greeting from your character.

scenes.name: Choose a character
scenes.description: Browse, pick, and hear who you are playing with.

scenes.name: Reach a new level
scenes.description: The marker climbs for 950 ms and celebrates on arrival.

scenes.name: Back one level
scenes.description: A gentle slide and an encouraging landing.

scenes.name: Reach the summit
scenes.description: The final climb, clouds opening, and a crown settling into place.

scenes.name: A new player name
scenes.description: Open the editor, roll a name, then save it.

scenes.name: Check the scores
scenes.description: Change the ranking period, refresh, and receive the updated board.

scenes.name: One more word
scenes.description: Press Next word and hear the new tiles settle.
